descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S15 Existing spec: another physician's patient never appears as a card or opens by URL

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room). (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)
  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 5)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given A patient owned by physician A; physician B signed in through the UI

When B looks at the list and opens /rounding/<A's patient id>

Then No card, and the chart does not render A's name or diagnosis

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (Hospital; NH isolation is in the api project and TC-21)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
